data.description: 【早濑优香 · 晄轮大祭冲线时刻】晄轮大祭热闹非凡的巨型体育场跑道旁，阳光洒在泛着微光的塑胶地面上。优香刚刚冲过终点线，微喘着单手扶着白毛巾擦拭泛红的脸颊，胸前的银色秒表随着急促的呼吸轻轻起伏——「呼……呼……怎么样老师？我的速度……没有辜负大家的期待吧！」
data.lighting: 明媚阳光直射与跑道漫射光
data.location: 晄轮大祭中央体育场跑道旁
data.promptProse: Just past the Halo Festival finish line, Yuuka catches her breath and wipes her flushed cheek with a white towel. Her unzipped navy track jacket and white sports shirt remain in the dynamic low medium view, a silver stopwatch hanging at her chest. Spectators rise beyond the track behind her. Direct sunshine highlights the towel and stopwatch, while the rubber surface reflects softer brightness beneath her halted running stance.
